spec.summary: Open-source IoT platform: devices connect over MQTT/HTTP/CoAP/LwM2M/SNMP transports, messages flow through a queue into a per-tenant actor-based rule engine, results land in SQL/Timescale/Cassandra storage, and a REST/WebSocket API plus an Angular UI serve tenants and customers.

contexts.name: Domain Model (common.data)
contexts.responsibility: Entities, ids, enums and DTOs shared by every module

contexts.name: Messaging (common.message, common.queue)
contexts.responsibility: Rule-engine message envelope and the queue abstraction over Kafka or in-memory

contexts.name: Actor Framework (common.actor)
contexts.responsibility: Mailbox-based actor runtime with dispatchers and failure strategies

contexts.name: Persistence (dao)
contexts.responsibility: DAO interfaces and SQL, timeseries and Cassandra implementations with caches

contexts.name: Rule Engine API
contexts.responsibility: Contract for rule nodes: TbNode, TbContext, configuration

contexts.name: Rule Node Library
contexts.responsibility: Built-in filter, enrichment, transform, action and external nodes

contexts.name: Transport API (common.transport)
contexts.responsibility: Session, auth and message plumbing every device protocol reuses

contexts.name: Protocol Transports
contexts.responsibility: MQTT, HTTP, CoAP, LwM2M and SNMP front doors, deployable alone

contexts.name: Actor System (application.actors)
contexts.responsibility: Tenant, device, rule chain and rule node actors that run the rule engine

contexts.name: Application Services
contexts.responsibility: Device state, subscriptions, provisioning, claiming, cluster routing, queue consumers

contexts.name: Security
contexts.responsibility: Login, JWT, OAuth2, MFA, role and group permission checks

contexts.name: REST and WebSocket API (application.controller)
contexts.responsibility: HTTP controllers and telemetry WebSocket endpoint

contexts.name: Angular UI (ui-ngx)
contexts.responsibility: Dashboards, entity management and rule chain editor in the browser

contexts.name: Microservice Packaging (msa)
contexts.responsibility: Docker images: tb-node, transports, js-executor, web-ui, edqs, vc-executor, integrations

contexts.name: Entity Data Query Service
contexts.responsibility: In-memory replica of entity data for fast entity queries
